scope: existing FinDKG quadruples and supplied entity/relation/time mappings

rules.predicate: head and tail both exist in entity-type mapping
quadruple timestamps fall within their chronological split interval
train, validation, and test time ranges are strictly chronological
exact quadruple recurrence is counted and preserved; cross-split exact overlap is reported
relation/head-type/tail-type signature must occur in earliest 80% of training time points for rows in final 20% of train
claim has source text and supports its relation semantically
claim is objectively true in the world
rules.failure: abstain; not decidable from graph structure
